items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; Charlie Shavers is only mentioned by the interviewer in relation to Tommy Dorsey and Red Allen.

ctx.x: We were playing at the Metropole and Roy, you know how he comes in? He said, "I got something for you. Play this." (....) I said, "That's no musicianship. You shouldn't do things like that." So he switched to another cut 'Body and Soul'. "Play this; play that." Buster got mad and went home and I walked off too...
Charlie didn't care; he just played.
